steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".

steps.saw: H2 "Don’t have the game? Download it today!" shown

steps.text: Are three badges shown in this section: "Google Play", "App Store" and "Web-Version"?
steps.saw: Three badges in a row: "GET IT ON Google Play", "Download on the App Store", "GET IT ON Web-Version" (each 137x48 link)

steps.text: Does the "Google Play" badge in this section link to a play.google.com address that contains "com.studion.mergearena" (read the link, do not open it)?
Does the "App Store" badge in this section link to an apps.apple.com address that contains "id6446642912" (read the link, do not open it)?
